en: Black‑and‑white view over a large European square with grand stone buildings. On the right stands a richly decorated neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire, tracery windows and buttresses. In the center is a monumental theater or opera house with a domed roof and classical façade. To the left are substantial civic buildings with steep roofs and a clock tower. The open square in front is mostly empty except for scattered pedestrians and a few trees without leaves, suggesting winter. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
